newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Riksbank reverse repo drains 32 bln SKR from markt.
newsitem.headline: Riksbank reverse repo drains 32 bln SKR from markt.

text.p: Sweden's central bank, the Riksbank, drained 32 billion crowns from the market in Tuesday morning's reverse repurchase operation.

The reverse repo was set at a lower 4.10 percent, a cut of 25 basis points, and will run from December 18 to January 8, replacing an earlier one-week operation that drained 39 billion crowns from the market.
The Riksbank said 13.42 percent of bids for the tender were allocated.
